title: A strike on a health care centre in Sudan killed at least 64 people, WHO says
summary: At least 64 people, including 13 children, were killed when a strike hit a hospital in Sudan’s East Darfur state, the World Health Organization (WHO) said Saturday. The total number of people killed in attacks on health care during Sudan's civil war has now surpassed 2,000, noted WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus after the strike.
